He claims to have opposed the Iran war from the outset, but when it began he only said we have to see how it plays out, and a week later he was willing to give Trump the benefit of the doubt.
He said to wake him when the no-war claim changed, but after US strikes on Iran's nuclear sites he redefines war as boots on the ground and says he is still right.
After the US struck Iran he still announces 'No war with Iran' instead of eating his words as he promised.
He had promised to denounce MAGA over a single US boot in Iran, but now says even if boots were there he does not care, voiding his own test in advance.
He claims to have said the same as the war warners, but earlier he declared no war with Iran and mocked those who expected one.
He claims to have explicitly opposed the war from the outset, but his early lines only voice skepticism, give Trump the benefit of the doubt, and hope it ends quickly.
He said to wake him when no war with Iran changed, but after the US struck Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan he redefined war as boots on the ground and said it did not happen.
After US strikes on Iran he still claims there was no war with Iran, holding the earlier forecast instead of eating his words.
He had promised to denounce MAGA over a single US boot in Iran, but now says that even if there were boots he does not care.
He had said there would be no war with Iran, but now speaks of it as happening and hopes it ends quickly.
His flat forecast that boots on the ground would not happen is softened to very little chance once the war resumes.

He claims he explicitly opposed the war from the outset, but on the first day he said only that boots would be a mistake and that we would see how it plays out, and later he gave Trump the benefit of the doubt.
